content:
[L] high | Customer effort table rows | CONVERSATION column is empty — rows show raw numeric IDs (2, 4) with no conversation identifier, leaving a huge blank first column.
[L] high | Bottom of window (Graph nodes table) | Table is clipped mid-row at the window edge with no visible scroll affordance or completion of the last row.
[C] high | Right half of the content area | The entire right side of the page is empty dead space while Health facts and QA cards occupy only the left half — massively unbalanced composition.
[C] high | Health facts / QA effectiveness cards | Cards have arbitrary differing widths (Health facts ~835px, QA card ~360px) with no grid, reading as ad-hoc debug panels.
[L] med | Health facts card metric tiles | Metric tiles have inconsistent widths and uneven gaps between them (tile edges not on a shared grid).
[L] med | Customer effort table ESCALATED column | The "—" values sit flush against the right card edge with no right padding, cramped against the border.
[S] med | Health facts tiles vs QA card tiles | Tile internal padding and label-to-value spacing differ between the two cards (QA tiles look slightly different in height and inset).
[S] med | Top-right time-range filter | The four range options (1 year, 90 days, 30 days, 7 days) are inconsistently spaced and the "30 days" pill baseline sits slightly off from the text links.
[S] med | Section vertical rhythm | Vertical gaps between Health facts → QA card (~30px) and QA card → Customer effort (~35px) and effort → Graph nodes (~35px) are uneven.
[H] med | Customer effort table header | ALL-CAPS headers (CONVERSATION, EFFORT, MESSAGES…) at tiny size with no visual pairing to the monospaced numeric body values.
[H] med | Health facts card subtitle vs body metrics | Card subtitles ("the last 30 days…", "scores persist per conversation…") render at near-identical weight to tile labels, mixing metadata with primary content.
[H] med | Stats presentation | Mixed typography: body font for some numbers, monospace for table values (48.0 h, 7.50), giving an unfinished/debug look.
[C] med | "avg first response" and "avg QA score" tiles | Em-dash placeholder occupies full tile with no "no data" state or explanation — reads as broken render.
[C] low | Health facts tile sublabels | "0.0% of conversations" and "33.3% of conversations" sublabels have inconsistent baseline placement relative to the big numbers.
[L] low | Insights tab underline | The active-tab underline collides with the mouse cursor drawn over it, and the underline is wider than the label text.
[S] low | Sync now button | Button is vertically misaligned with the adjacent time-range links (sits higher than their baseline).
[H] low | Graph nodes form row | Labels (Kind, Label, Entity id, Properties (JSON)) and inputs share the same size/weight with cramped ~8px gaps between field groups.
[C] low | Customer effort header area | Yellow badge and "Recompute (last 100 closed)" button are floating inline with uneven gap, ungrouped from the table below.

VERDICT: unprofessional — half-empty canvas, clipped table, empty columns, and inconsistent metrics typography make this read as a debug dashboard, not a product.
